review_description: They had promised to install the solar battery in July and after making the payment and waiting for over 3 months they have gone missing.No phone calls and emails.

Let me explain the experience.Signed up for a community battery in October 2024. Paid 8k, started raising the issues in March 2025 via email that our bills were a lot more expensive. Communication from company is poor and so is the customer service.In April 2025, after numerous calls and emails I asked for pricing for a physical battery that was going to be more suitable for us. No response, crickets. Until this date, never had an accurate electricity bill.In August 2025 after waiting months, finally got hold of the ‘owner’ who insisted we couldn’t get a refund on the community battery and we would have to pay the full price of a battery. I asked if we could transfer the amount we paid for the community battery and pay the difference for a physical and we were shut down. The ethical practice of this company bewilders me. Made a complaint to NSW Fair Trading. Buyer beware before proceeding with this company. If you don’t care about honest communication being ripped off and complete transparency, sign up with these guys

From the start Macarthur Solar were great. The sales team went through our options and explained everything in simple terms and discussed the different types of solar systems. After doing some more research on string, vs DC optimised vs micro inverter we chose to go with a Solaredge DC optimised system which we are pleased with so far.The installation was done ahead of schedule and went very smoothly and the workmanship of the install is exactly what I was looking for.Overall a great experience and already we are seeing a dramatic reduction in our projected electricity bill.

We chose MacArthur Solar after careful research and receiving several competitive quotes. They distinguished themselves by good service, clear information and courteous, patient listening.The installation went ahead as planned. There was one small issue which they identified remotely a couple of days later. They called to let us know and it was fixed the next day.We are pleased with the performance so far, with the 24 panels covering the bulk of the daytime air conditioning for our 288m square house.

Installer listened to my needs and how I preferred the panel locations. The quote was quick and covered 2 different size systems to choose from. They did a great job and very neat with all work done.Contacted me a week in advance of the installation date to confirm everything. Arrived at the time agreed and finished in the day. Asked my wife and I for input during the installation process to ensure we were both happy with what they were doing. They put the inverter control in the garage near to the power fuse box and main supply box without any problems. Once the job was completed, they made sure we were both involved when explaining the next steps to get the system up and working. They contacted my electricity provider to ensure a smart meter was to be installed. They also gave me contact information should I have any questions at a later time. They showed us the ways I could be sure the panels were working fully. Even provided a solar panel cleaning service for the next 5 years as part of the job. From the first meeting, the quote and install process, they were very professional and easy to deal with.
Extremely polite, punctual, tidy and customer focusedRealy!!!!! you want more words words words words words
Quote was easy, installation hassle free. Installers were prompt, polite & left everything clean. Panels were installed 2 days after all wiring & electrical due to high winds. Great service.
From quoting to installation, this company is a pleasure to deal with. It is important we support these Australian companies and not overseas call centers

I would highly recommend Macarthur Solar to anyone seeking solar. Tim came to our home, wasnt at all pushy like most sales reps, was very informative about the products on offer and left his details with any queries i had, even from other solar companies! The crew that installed the panels were very polite, quite while doing the work and very tidy, taking away every last bit of rubbish. They removed our old pool heating system from the roof and capped the pipes which saved me doing it.Having issue's with space for the meter installation from the retailer, Mathew was quick to extend his service to ensure that the final piece of the puzzle was completed correctly. He went above and beyond and completley outside his scope of work to help. An all round 5 star service from start to finish.
Quote was quick, understood my requirements. Install was only a few weeks later. System works well.

Tim was great for making all the journey out and studying the year worth of utility bills to suggest the different solutions for us. There was a significant delay from paying the deposit to actual installation due to availability of supply outside of their control, I got so frustrated that at one stage was planning to cancel the order, glad I persistent - good lesson in being patient. The installers are really friendly and professional, clean up after the installation, wow! Certainly worth supporting the local business.

Macarthur Solar were quick to respond to my request for a quote. Tim listened to what we wanted and quoted accordingly. He was very knowledgeable and helpful. The installation team worked quickly and professionally. Everything was left tidy. Customer service has been second to none. We cannot fault Macarthur Solar for their care and professionalism from the quote to the installation. After sales service has been wonderful; they have  been able to answer any questions or queries immediately. Would thoroughly recommend Macarthur Solar.

The sales process was quite easy. They was not the cheapest however appeared to a reliable company that did all the work themselves .The installation was brought forward early due to a cancellation. The team of 3 had the system up and running by the middle of the afternoon. They were quick and efficient and the install looks great.Still waiting for the smart meter to be installed but very happy with the whole process and the quality of the system and the installation. A quality job by a quality team.

Ben came to site was informative talked us through the whole process. Other company's didn't attend. Out of the three quote,s one was too much one was cheaper. I asked MacArthur solar to go through the quote. They were happy to do so and pointed out the difference.They were approachable. The install was done in a timely manner. We had a positive experience

The 3 installers I took quotes from all gave similar pricing and designed similar systems and I am sure all 3 would have done a decent job. Ultimately, I wanted the best system I could find as the cost was not a primary consideration in my decision making process. Macarthur ticked all the boxes and I was comfortable with what they were telling me. I had a hard look at the design and projected savings and found them to be realistic, as distinct from one or two others that were rather optimistic, shall we say. As a retired Inspector, I have seen some shoddy solar installs over the years (especially years ago when the industry was booming) and did not want any nasty little surprises at my own house, so I asked a lot of hard questions and explored all the possible arrangements that would best suit my house. Even though they were busy due to the constant rain at that time, they managed to do the job within a reasonable time frame and without too many problems, even replacing a few damaged or cracked tiles on my roof that I did not know about. I would recommend this company for anyone thinking of installing a solar generation system at their own house. It is hard to say anything negative about the whole process, which is better than I had expected as some installers are only interested in doing the job quickly, getting paid and going home. I did not get this impression with Macarthur.
I was pleased with Macarthur Solar. The right mix of following up whilst not being pushy. Prompt service. Friendly staff.I recommend Macarthur Solar.
Quotes within requested range.Installation smooth despite inclement weather. Polite and tidy.Still waiting for power company to install smart meter
sales/quoting was excellentinstallation was great the team were polite tidy and punctualthey did organise the grid connection after the install

Right from quoting stage through to installation, these guys gave me confidence that I was dealing with people who cared about the final product as well as making sure I was fully informed and happy.Having done some research but not being an expert I relied on honesty and integrity and was not disappointed with what I was provided. They came out and did an initial site visit and talked me through everything where most other companies just do it from Google maps, these guys do both if you request it.We have had issues with our power Company and the meter conversion/accurate readings etc and since the switch to solar, we are yet to see the savings which is disappointing but more a power Company issue than a MacArthur Solar issue.Overall happy with the product.
Macarthur Energy had a great price for top of the range equipment I am also very happy with the customer service

Highly recommend Matthew who was very helpful with the paperwork from start to finish. Despite delays due to Covid restrictions the system was finally put in and installation was excellent. Macarthur Solar was excellent to deal with and would recommend them to anyone looking for a solar system.

8.58 kW, Hyundai 22 x 390 W panels (HIE-S390UF) + Fronius Primo 8.2kW Inverter (8.2-1 INT) + Fronius Single Smart Meter + Clenergy Defender (Bird Protection) + relocation of aerial.Sales was awesome Paul was very informative and friendly, he appreciated any question I asked.The installation went well, the boys were polite, helpful, tidy and friendly during this process.We spoke to the boys, who went through the process of reading and seeing the solar and how it works.We have also looked on YouTube regarding reading the inverter and other information.They are contacting our energy supply to have replace our smart meter.Great Company, would highly recommend this company.

Mathew and his team from Macarthur Energy completed the installation within the agreed timeframe, quality of the installation was extremely high with real attention given to detail.Only quality materials were used to complete the installation, value for money is important.Solar panel layout on my roof was completed in a way that looks good from a street view and have received lots of positive feedback from neighbours.Professional advice provided before the installation has achieved a great outcome, Hyundai solar panels and  Fronius Primo inverter  installed meet and exceed the power generation required which is now delivering significant financial savings which is outstanding.Both panels and inverter are also supported by a factory warranty from companies that are well known that will support their products in the future in the event any issues arise.If you are considering installing a solar system I have no hesitation recommending Macarthur Solar which  has a sound  trading record with a good name within the industry.

Mat from Macrthur Solar was by far the best person to deal with. The price and quality of the product available was superior than competitors. Macarthur Solar installed a 10.5kw system with Hyundai panels and Fronius inverterThere was no hard sell from Mat. Mat was the one person you liaise with who also installed and followed up ensuring i was happy with the system output. There was no middle person, Mat was the person you liaise with from start to end.Mat was available before installation to answer my many questions about the products available and best options for energy plans (flat rate vs time of day).I couldn’t find one fault with the service and highly recommend them to anyone - including my family and friends (which I already have).Steve

Quote process was great, with him taking the time to answer my questions openly and honestly, and design a great system.Good communication leading up to the install, and installation day is my only criticism - I didn't have strong preferences for panel placement (just wherever was optimal for solar capture), but the panels did not end up where we agreed, and I only discovered that myself at a later date. I suspect the panels just ended up where it was easiest for the install team rather than what was best for the system design.Good support since install as well, would recommend Macarthur Solar.

The team at Macathur energy were easy to deal with and happy to answer each of my many questions. They showed a willingness to understand what we wanted to achieve and then tailored the system to meet our requirements. I have no hesitation in recommending them.
Great and neat install. No real interruption of daily life for disabled person living there

From the first phone call to the finished installation I couldn’t be happier.The guys at MacArthur solar went above and beyond to give me the system I requested. They steered me in the right direction and listened to my needs. They treated myself and my property with respect and the after sales service has been great, they aren’t the sort of company that just slaps the job together and then never hear from them again. The quality in my installation is evident and these guys have shown they are good tradesmen that care about what they are doing.Very happy customer here and highly recommend Macarthur solar.

From start to finish the team were great, they communicated well and offered me solution for me not just to make a sale. The team who installed the job were professional, they were clean, quite (as possible), friendly and helpful. If you get solar through this team you will not be disappointed. I have already recommended them to family and friends.

The quoting process by the 3 quoting companies was very similar and all three had good reviews. Choose Macarthur Energy as they had the best price, their office is local and the panels, although not the most sought after, had good reviews.  They arrived on time, 7:30 am, removed the old system and installed the new one, connected to the grid and finished at 3:00 pm.  They returned the next day to setup the monitoring and explained everything clearly and were very helpful.  Very happy with the service.
Paul Smith and his team are fantastic from start up to completed installing the system. They are very helpful and explains to you whats going to happen next and what to expect. Kuddos to this team.

The entire process was great from the quoting Stage to the install.Paul was able to answer all of our questions In the initial stages and Matt and the install team were extremely professional.Highly recommend the the team at Macarthur Energy.
Quoted quickly. Could answer all questions about the system. Neat and tidy installation
Very easy to deal with.  Good communication.  Installation team were very professional.

Highly recommend. Paul, Matthew, Benny, and the rest of the team at Macarthur Energy are some of the most helpful people I have dealt with. They are incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and professional.The installers treated my home with respect, and worked diligently throughout the unusually hot day. The installation itself looks very neat and the inverter is out of the way. I couldn't be more grateful for their hard work.The 6.6kw system itself (Hyundai panels, Fronius inverter) generated roughly 35kWh today, which I'm very happy with considering I had the aircon on all day.All in all, I am very satisfied and wouldn't hesitate to recommend this to anyone.
Polite and professional and very happy with the system. I would reccommend Macarthur energy.

We can't speak highly enough of Paul, Matt and the team at Macarthur Energy.The pre-sales support:I spent a considerable amount of time with Paul and asked all the questions I could think off and guided by the solar quotes website, they were all promptly answered and put me at ease that these guys knew their stuff.Install day:A few weeks later (always communicated by Paul) a team turned up on schedule, with flawless execution they had the panels up and running without us even knowing they were here, not only were they efficient but friendly, polite and above all treated my home like it was theirs and made sure nothing was damaged, dirtied or taken out of place.At the end of the day and the install we would not have known any work was done if not for the panels on the roof and the inverter neatly in the garage.The panels:Paul suggested Hyundai panels and a Fronius inverter, and my goodness was he on the money. First day and a gorgeous Sydney day the panels produced 40kw of power, absolutely incredible for a 6.6kw system. And in typical Sydney fashion, day 2 was overcast all day and gloomy, yet with no sun we still got 2-3kw per hour all day which covers our usage and plenty left.The inverter with built in wifi is a great way to monitor the power production and efficiency and a it of fun.Overall we are extremely happy with the install and Macarthur Energy and its a competitive and confusing market in Solar but these guys just made it all to simple. Highly recommended.
Really happy with the sales / quote / installation / customer service great.

Great all round. The sales process was simple and clear. Great customer service with all all my questions being answered, very helpful!When it came to instal the team was very experienced and extremely happy with the workmanship. Tidy finish which was difficult on my two story home.I highly recommend Macarthur Energy!!

Although all 3 quotes we received from companies via SolarQuotes were prompt detailed & the sales staff courteous & helpful we decided to go with a local company Macarthur Energy who I found in the reviews section on SolarQuotes.They came to inspect the property before quoting which was important to my husband & they provided an alternative layout which gave us a bigger system.The workmanship & competence was excellent & surpassed our expectations. It was necessary to dig up part of a garden & paving for wiring purposes &we were pleasantly surprised at how neatly this was done. you couldn't tell anything had been disturbed...brilliant.We received the paperwork to give to the energy supplier & that has gone without a hitch.We were very impressed with Macarthur Energy.

Matthew was fantastic we are baby boomers and like to speak face to face. Matthew offered this service, sat with us and explained all aspects of the system. Thank you Finn for your informative web site and installers that we could trust.
Mat was a great person to deal with. He was very knowledgeable and could answer any and every question that I had. Workmen were prompt and seemed to provide a quality service.
Very knowledgeable and trustworthy

The quality of the work done looks neat and tidy and he was considerate of the aesthetic impact of the panels on the house and helped us to find a position that worked well for us. Mathew from MacArthur Energy have been fantastic to work with all along the process. I got a quick quote, a valid estimate of the wait time before I made the deposit. We planned a date that worked for me. The installation crew (including Mathew) came on that date. Installation took 2 days as planned.  It is a neat installation. During the process Mathew offered to install the inverter in my garage instead of outside. It would have been a north facing wall otherwise. This was obviously more work so I offered payment for it, which Mathew declined! The installation has been running for a month now without issues. The output is in line with the estimate (1.15MWh for just above a month).I can only highly recommend them!
